scope.task: Close the three open G1+ tickets with read-only agents: vinylene carbonate, fluoroethylene carbonate, 3-methoxypropionitrile
scope.coordinator_role: froze the write set, re-checked quotes against the tracked local caches, merged the evidence, changed no canonical data
scope.rate_limit_notes: No HTTP 429 retry storm was issued by any agent. Two agents exceeded the coordinator's 40-call sub-cap; that breach is recorded, not smoothed over.

evidence_policy.blocked_is_not_absent: Every blocked path names a document and an access failure. No ticket is written as no data.
evidence_policy.no_value_promotion: No stored dielectric value, temperature, digit count, evidence level or model_ready flag changed in this round.
evidence_policy.verbatim_quotes: Every quote below is transcribed as reported by the agent that saw the page unless its recheck_status is coordinator, in which case the coordinator re-derived the same string from a tracked local cache. No quote is presented as coordinator-verified when it is agent_only.
evidence_policy.precision_rule: A source printed as an integer stays an integer; stored decimals are never re-derived from an integer source.

findings.claim: The stored FEC dielectric value 102 is the flash point in degrees Celsius, not a permittivity. The conflict ticket is therefore 78.4 vs 107, not 78.4 vs 102 vs 107.

evidence.column_header_quote: Melting temperature Tm [C] | Boiling temperature Tb [C] | Viscosity eta [cP] | Dielectric constant eps | Flash point Tf [C] | Density rho [g cm-3]
evidence.reading: 102 sits in the Flash point column while 78.4 sits in the Dielectric constant column of the same row.

evidence.source: Wang et al. 2023, Adv. Funct. Mater. 33, 2212342, Table S3
evidence.reading: ECW-308 itself carries 78.40 as the dielectric value and 130.00 as the flash point, so ECW-308 does not support 102 either.

evidence.source: Deng et al. 2020, Energy Storage Mater. 32, 425
evidence.reading: Read in full by the agent; the string 78.4 occurs zero times in the paper, so the [42] relay cannot be the source of the 78.4 leg.

evidence.source: Ue et al. 2014, chapter in Electrolytes for Lithium and Lithium-Ion Batteries, Table 2.3
evidence.reading: A compilation table. It supports the 107 leg but is not a primary measurement; the chapter states its tables summarise refs [4, 5].

evidence.access_evidence: Semantic Scholar reports openAccessPdf.status CLOSED with a null abstract; the publisher PDF returned HTTP 403; both J-Stage candidates returned HTTP 404.
evidence.reading: Named candidate primary measurement for the 107 leg. Not retrieved, therefore not evaluated.

findings.consequence: The stored dielectric value is a protected field and is left byte-identical; the row stays model_ready=false. Re-basing conflict_status is deferred to the next dataset revision with the patch rows recorded under pending_patch_rows.

findings.claim: 126 is printed as an integer at 25 C in two distinct review-level tables. Their independence is NOT established: neither table carries a per-value citation for its VC row, and the known primary measurement (Saadi and Lee 1966) remains blocked, so both tables may relay it. One modern citation chain that looks independent resolves back to the second of the two tables.

evidence.source: Hall et al. 2018, J. Electrochem. Soc. 165, A2365, Table II
evidence.temperature_quote: Physical properties are reported at 25 C or as noted.
evidence.reading: The table is Table II, not Table I as earlier notes recorded; the correction is recorded here.

evidence.source: Vali, Janes and Lust 2016, J. Electrochem. Soc. 163, A851
evidence.reading: Open access. This is the clearest readable binding of 126 to 25 C, but it is a compiled table and the VC row carries no per-value citation.

evidence.quote: Due to its high dielectric constant (126 at 298 K), [29] the excited states of VC ... are neglected hereafter.
evidence.reading: Reference [29] resolves to Vali, Janes and Lust 2016, so this is a relay of the same table and is not an independent confirmation.

evidence.source: Saadi and Lee 1966, J. Chem. Soc. B, 5-6
evidence.access_evidence: The RSC landing page returned a Cloudflare interstitial; the abstract line is readable in search results but the two-page full text was not.
evidence.abstract_quote: The dielectric constant and dipole moment of vinylene carbonate have been measured, and the alkaline hydrolysis of this ester in ...
evidence.reading: Confirms a measurement exists and confirms the value cannot be read from the accessible text. No paywall circumvention was used.
The Knovel table itself was not retrieved this round, so the interval is neither confirmed nor used as a competing value.

findings.consequence: No field changed. 126 remains an integer at nominal 25 C in the dataset; the row stays model_ready=false and conflict_open, because two distinct review tables are still neither a readable primary measurement nor a demonstrated independent pair.

findings.claim: The stored 36.0 traces through the open Perricone 2011 thesis to Ue, Ida and Mori 1994. Every readable source prints the two-significant-figure integer 36, so the stored decimal over-states the precision.

evidence.header_quote: Solvant | Tfu (C) | Teb (C) | FP (C) | eta a 25C (mPa.s) | eps_r a 25C | Moment dipolaire (D) | DN AN
evidence.reading: The permittivity column is explicitly headed at 25 C, so the temperature is locked to 25 C for this value.

evidence.source: Perricone 2011 thesis, body text, EC / MP mixture section
evidence.row_quote: du MP (eps_r = 36, DN = 14,6, eta = 0,89 mPa.s a 40C)
evidence.reading: The body text repeats eps_r = 36 and attaches 40 C only to the viscosity, not to the permittivity.

evidence.quote: Ue, M., K. Ida, and S. Mori, Electrochemical Properties of Organic Liquid Electrolytes Based on Quaternary Onium Salts for Electrical Double-Layer Capacitors, Journal of the Electrochemical Society, 1994. 141(11): p. 2989-2996.
evidence.reading: The coordinator independently confirmed the thesis cites Ue et al. as [43] in the surrounding text (Ue et al. [43, 51] ont mesure les conductivites ioniques ...). This turns a nameless relay into a named primary candidate.

evidence.source: Yen et al. 2022, Electrochim. Acta 411, 141105, Table 1
evidence.reading: Second, independent review-level confirmation. Its own reference [27] is the 2013 Encyclopedia of Electrochemical Power Sources, so it is still not a primary measurement.

evidence.source: Ue, Ida and Mori 1994, J. Electrochem. Soc. 141, 2989
evidence.access_evidence: OpenAlex marks the DOI OA=False; only a CiteSeerX submittedVersion record was found and it redirects to an archive.org host that does not connect.
evidence.reading: Named primary candidate. Its table, frequency and method remain unverified, so the finding does not promote the row to found_primary.

findings.consequence: No field changed. The row keeps evidence_level=secondary_compilation_unverified and model_ready=false, but the open ticket is now specific: retrieve Ue, Ida and Mori 1994 (DOI 10.1149/1.2059270) and read its permittivity table.

pending_patch_rows.rationale: Luo et al. 2021 Adv. Sci. places 102 in the Flash point column of the same row whose Dielectric constant column holds 78.4, so the stored 102 is a category error rather than a competing permittivity.

pending_patch_rows.value: Stored 102 is the flash point (102 C) of FEC, not a permittivity: Luo et al. 2021 Adv. Sci. 8 2101051 Table 1 prints 78.4 under Dielectric constant and 102 under Flash point for the same row. ECW-308 carries 78.40 as the dielectric value and 130.00 as the flash point. The dielectric legs are 78.4 (ECW-308 [16, 42]; Deng 2020 was read in full and does not contain 78.4) and 107 (Ue et al. 2014 Table 2.3). Neither leg has a readable primary measurement; Hagiyama 2008 Chem. Lett. 37 210 is the named candidate for the 107 leg and is blocked. No value is averaged or swapped.
pending_patch_rows.rationale: Records the category error and the two surviving dielectric legs without editing the protected dielectric or T_K fields.

honest_boundary: Two of the three agents exceeded the 40-call per-agent sub-cap (77 and 55 reported). The user's 500-calls-per-hour ceiling was not approached in aggregate (172 reported), but the sub-cap breach is recorded rather than presented as compliance.
Blocked access is not absence of data: every blocked path in this round names a document and the specific failure.

A review table is not a primary measurement, and two distinct review tables are not a demonstrated independent pair. Vinylene carbonate and 3-methoxypropionitrile both gain corroboration without being promoted, and the VC finding states explicitly that independence is not established.

The stored FEC value 102 is retained byte-for-byte because the dataset is frozen and the value is a protected field; correcting it requires a new dataset revision, and the exact patch rows are recorded under pending_patch_rows.
No claim is made about compounds outside the frozen 246-row dataset.
